o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آلما (alma), from Proto-Common Turkic *alma.
Internationalism; likely via Russian преамбула (preambula), from French préambule, ultimately from Medieval Latin praeambulum.
From Proto-Turkic *söje- (“to prop, lean, support”). Cognate with Chuvash сӗвен (sĕven, “to stick to, cling to”), etc.
